workshoptitle: Build Connected Healthcare Solutions with Oracle AI Database

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: The Seer Health Network care operations story and workshop goals.

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Launch the environment and open Database Actions SQL Worksheet.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Build a Converged Dashboard Query
tutorials.description: Use a converged query to connect care-service pressure, request activity, semantic relevance, and logistics distance.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Build a JSON Care Service Request Model
tutorials.description: Help Thomas compare JSON columns, JSON collections, and JSON Relational Duality for a healthcare operations application.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Review a Semantic Care Operations Search
tutorials.description: Review how Gilly uses an in-database embedding model to find related care services and quality and capacity signals.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Investigate Connected Care Pathways
tutorials.description: Review how Bob uses Oracle Property Graph, SQL/PGQ, and Graph Studio to trace connected care facts and quality-signal evidence.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Route Care Requests to the Closest Qualified Logistics Site
tutorials.description: Review how Moon combines Oracle Spatial distance with service, status, load, and capacity evidence to route a care request.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Build a Care Demand Risk Model with Oracle Machine Learning
tutorials.description: Train and score a care-demand risk model inside Oracle AI Database.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Ask Healthcare Questions with Select AI
tutorials.description: Use Select AI to turn natural-language healthcare questions into SQL you can inspect and run.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Build a Healthcare Agent with Select AI Agent
tutorials.description: Create a read-only healthcare agent that uses an approved SQL tool.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Final Quiz
tutorials.description: Check your understanding with scored questions.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving Live Help.
